reconcile.note: Fausset reads the evil Isaiah says God creates as calamity and disaster set against peace, not the moral evil of sin condemned elsewhere in scripture.

discrepancy.note: Troki reads Isaiah 45:7 as literal doctrine that the one God directly wills both good and evil, not a metaphor softened elsewhere.

quotes.text: He forineth light and createth darkness, maketh peace and createth evil; I the Lord am doing all these things.
quotes.attr: Isaac ben Abraham Troki (d. 1594), Faith Strengthened (Chizzuk Emunah), trans. Moses Mocatta (1851), pt. I, on Isaiah 45:7.

sides.snippet: I make peace, and create evil
sides.verseText: I form the light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.
He who doesn't love doesn't know God, for God is love.
